subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Aspirations give us the clarity of our goals.

options.text: The clarity of our goals has been given by aspirations.
The clarity is given of our goals by aspirations.
The clarity of our goals are given by aspirations.
The clarity of our goals is given by aspirations.

solution:
The correct answer is: ***The clarity of our goals is given by aspirations.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Given the sentence is 

Aspirations give us clarity about our goals. 

 
• After analyzing the sentence it is observed the tense is **simple present tense.**
 
• So the rule to convert the active voice to passive voice is object+am/is/are+third from of do verb+by+object.
 
• Here the **Aspirations** is the **subject** and **the clarity of goals** is the** object** and **give** is the **do verb**.

So the **passive voice** of the sentence is:*** ******The clarity of our goals is given by aspirations.*** So ***option(4)*** is correct.
